questions.question: Which command installs the Angular CLI so that `ng` is available in any terminal?
questions.explanation: The CLI is the `@angular/cli` npm package; installing it globally with `-g` puts the `ng` command on your PATH.

questions.question: What does `ng serve` do?
options: Deploys the app to a production server
Starts a development server (by default on localhost:4200) that rebuilds on every save
questions.explanation: `ng serve` compiles the app in memory, serves it locally on port 4200 by default, and rebuilds when files change.

questions.question: Which generated file is the entry point that bootstraps the root component?
questions.explanation: `src/main.ts` is the entry point; it bootstraps the root component with the app configuration.

questions.question: In a template, what does `{{ budget }}` do?
options: Interpolates the value of the component's `budget` property into the page
Declares a new variable called budget
Binds a click event to a method named budget
questions.explanation: Double curly braces are interpolation: Angular renders the current value of the matching class property as text.
